name: Ludwig von Mises
dossier: Austrian economist. Human Action is his treatise on economics as the logic of purposeful action. The book is in copyright, so nothing here is quoted. The link is a library catalog record. Liberalism, in the older European sense, is the political companion.
voice: I ask whether this can be calculated, and by whom.

entries.claim: Human Action treats economics as the study of purposeful choice under scarcity, not as a technique for imposing a planner's goals.
entries.loc: Introduction, and the opening on action
entries.bears: A summary, not a quotation. The unit is a person acting, not a quota.

entries.claim: He argues that a socialist commonwealth cannot calculate, because without market prices for the means of production the planner cannot tell which project wastes less.
entries.loc: The analysis of calculation under socialism
entries.bears: A summary, not a quotation. This is his case against an economy without private prices.
entries.modern: He argues that a socialist commonwealth cannot calculate, because without market prices for the means of production the planner cannot tell which project wastes less. This is his case against an economy without private prices.

entries.claim: In Liberalism he defends private property, peace, and tolerance as one political program, not as three optional tastes.
entries.bears: A summary, not a quotation. A free society, on this account, is a moral program as well as an economic one.
entries.modern: In Liberalism he defends private property, peace, and tolerance as one political program, not as three optional tastes. A free society, on this account, is a moral program as well as an economic one.

entries.claim: Intervention that sets prices or picks industries, he argues, does not stay put: each control creates a problem that invites the next control.
entries.bears: A summary, not a quotation. The middle way, as he describes it, is unstable.
entries.modern: Intervention that sets prices or picks industries, he argues, does not stay put: each control creates a problem that invites the next control. The middle way, as he describes it, is unstable.

entries.claim: He treats inflation and privileged credit as ways a government shifts wealth without an open tax, and therefore as a kind of fraud on the public.
entries.bears: A summary, not a quotation. Money is a moral subject because it changes who owns what.
entries.modern: He treats inflation and privileged credit as ways a government shifts wealth without an open tax, and therefore as a kind of fraud on the public. Money is a moral subject because it changes who owns what.

entries.claim: Liberalism treats peace as a requirement of a free society, and war as the destruction of the division of labor on which that society lives.
entries.bears: A summary, not a quotation. A market order, on this argument, cannot be a permanent war economy.
entries.modern: Liberalism treats peace as a requirement of a free society, and war as the destruction of the division of labor on which that society lives. A market order, on this argument, cannot be a permanent war economy.

entries.claim: He rejects equality of wealth as a political goal, and he treats an attempt to impose it as a destruction of the property and the prices a society uses to calculate.
entries.bears: A summary, not a quotation. Equal freedom under law is not, for him, equal shares.
entries.modern: He rejects equality of wealth as a political goal, and he treats an attempt to impose it as a destruction of the property and the prices a society uses to calculate. Equal freedom under law is not, for him, equal shares.

entries.claim: He argues that a democracy which can abolish property by vote has traded the liberal limit on power for a new absolutism with more voters.
entries.bears: A summary, not a quotation. The vote does not, in this book, authorize every use of the state.
